Name: Queerify Stardew Valley- LGBT Interactions
Author: WitchWeed
Description:
[size=3]Hi, and welcome to Queerify Stardew Valley! 

This touches many vanilla dialogue lines and events to ensure that the least straight dialogue options are displayed. [b]SVE Characters added in 1.1 update![/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod[/url] already touches many of these vanilla lines (although not all!), but often in a way that leaves the players orientation ambiguous. This mod aims to give players an alternative to that experience by intentionally having NPCs perceive any relationships the player is in as queer, in a vanilla-esq way. Notably, it touches on George's homophobic lines without removing acknowledgements of his problematic beliefs entirely, ensures romantic events that are gender-specific show the queer dialogue regardless of player's assigned gender, and allows gender-locked generic dialogue lines to show for everyone. A list of some of the lines before and after can be found in the spoiler below! [/size]

[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3]vanilla George 10 hearts line:  "I'll admit, I thought it was... strange... for two men to be together. But you're such a nice young man, and I know you two are in love... I've changed my mind" for male farmers, or "You're part of the family, now... and I couldn't be more proud." for female farmers[/size]
[*][size=3] ﻿modded: "I'll admit, I ...struggled... with your and Alex's relationship at first. But you're such a nice young person, and I know you two are in love... I was wrong before." the previously female-specific line will be shown half the time as well if you use PPAF or Gender Neutrality Mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]vanilla Elliott boat event response: "... I was worried you might not feel this way about another man." for male farmers, or "So am I." for female farmers.[/size]
[*][size=3] ﻿modded: "... I was worried you might not be attracted to men."[/size]
[*][size=3]vanilla Sebastian dating line: "Don't make fun of me... but I've never been in a relationship like this before." for male farmers, "Don't make fun of me... but I've never really had a girlfriend before." for female farmers[/size]
[*][size=3] ﻿modded: "Don't make fun of me... but I've never been in a relationship like this before."[/size]
[*][size=3]vanilla married rainy dialogue: "The rain makes our home seem so cozy." for male farmers, "It's nights like this I'm glad we have a quality roof." for female farmers[/size]
[*][size=3] ﻿modded: both lines display with equal chances for either[/size]
[/list][/spoiler]

[u]1.1 Update:[/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]SVE characters Sophia and Victor added. [b]This patch requires you to have [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18228]GNMTokens For SVE[/url][b].[/b] I do not use SVE, and do not intend to continue support for SVE beyond what this patch adds (unless this patch is broken in future SVE updates, in which case it will be maintained as best I can)[/size]
[*][size=3]Platonic Partners and Friendships compatibility is done!! Queerify Interactions now checks PPAF's settings and applies edits accordingly. If you have any issues with or ideas for this patch, please feel free to reach out!﻿[/size]
[/list]

[u]Future Updates:[/u]
[list]
[*][size=3][s]increased compat with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]﻿ (some compat currently included)[/s] Added in Version 1.1![/size]
[*][size=3]queerifying expansion mods and other dialogue expansions (please check the compat article for a list of current and planned compat, and feel free to reach out about any mods you'd be interested in me including!)[/size]
[*][size=3]adding questions and unique interactions based on the player's orientation and described gender identity[/size]
[/list]﻿

[b][u]Please Note:[/u] This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14426]GNMTokens[/url] to work properly! It also will not work for SVE without both SVE and The GNMTokens for SVE mod from JayJayDub. [/b]
